notes: The main Scene owns one RenderSet entity with 10000 instances; the independent RoomEnvironment Scene owns one RenderSet with eight entities.
The fixed r185 DFG edge, dielectric multiscattering, RoomEnvironment capture/convolution sequence, explicit sRGB mip chain, and Neutral tone mapping are private DSL work.
An analytic screen Jacobian selects the explicit texture LOD, preserving the upstream mip response while eliminating Vulkan implicit-derivative repeat drift.
All three scenarios pass Legacy/Experimental on Metal/Vulkan for three byte-stable repetitions with single-sample rendering and no MSAA simulation.
